mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_balance_account (settlement_customer_id, settlement_customer_name_snapshot, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{settlementCustomerId}, #{settlementCustomerNameSnapshot}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (settlement_customer_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE DO NOTHING
